lines.text: The angry commanders told Achish to send David back, fearing he would turn adversary and win back Saul's favor.
Achish told David to go in peace, because the Philistine leaders approved of him, though Achish found him upright.

lines.text: David and his men rose early to return to the land of Judah, while the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

problems.problem: It has 24 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.
